summary: Iteration 4 — completed the missing coverage requested. (1) Reproduced ProtectedRoute deep-link bug (state.from was pathname only) and applied the approved one-line fix so state.from now includes pathname+search+hash; verified end-to-end via Playwright: logged-out visit to /compte?order=<id>#focus and /admin/commandes?order=<id> both redirect to /connexion, then after login land back on the FULL original URL with focused-order panel visible. (2) Added 13 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter4_missing.py covering: push service _send genuine VAPID signing+encryption with MOCKED HTTP transport (asserts endpoint URL, VAPID Authorization header, aes128gcm Content-Encoding, non-empty encrypted body); send_push 404/410 → deletes subscription (returns 'expired'); send_push 500 and requests.Timeout → subscription retained (returns 'failed'); notify_new_order dispatches ONLY to admin subscriptions and prunes orphaned non-admin subs; new-order dispatch flow (order 201 then dup 409 does not schedule); chat pagination with 55 messages verifies page1=50/has_more=true and older-page via ?before= returns exactly the remaining 5 with no overlap; unread does not increase for own-sent messages; admin reply creates customer unread. Also added subscription-rule extras: Prime→Prime+ refused (409 FR), mixed cart (UC+Prime) reserves slot, cancelled/failed prior sub still blocks. Full suite: 82 passed / 2 skipped / 0 failed (~137s). yarn build clean (Compiled successfully, main.f602a497.js 319.15 kB gz, no warnings). No secrets printed in tests or report.

coverage_matrix.push_frontend_notes: MOCKED at the pywebpush transport layer for deterministic unit tests. Real browser permission grant/deny/default and OS-level FCM delivery remain a MANUAL step (headless Chrome cannot obtain a real subscription with a user gesture in this preview). AdminPush panel's 'refusées' state and denied-help copy were verified in iteration 3; not regressed.

chat_missing_cases.hidden_tab_does_not_mark_read_note: Backend never marks read implicitly — /read is client-initiated only. Client tab-visibility guard in ChatContext should therefore continue to gate the /read call; this is a pure frontend concern verified by code review (no automated headless test can simulate the OS-level Page Visibility API reliably).

coverage_matrix.final_build: yarn build → Compiled successfully. No warnings. Bundle 319.15 kB gz (main), 12.98 kB gz (css).

critical_code_review_comments: ProtectedRoute now preserves the full target URL (pathname+search+hash) in navigation state, enabling notification/email deep-links to survive a login round-trip. AuthPage L19 already reads location.state?.from unchanged, so no coordinated change was needed.

services/push.py: _send is intentionally sync and offloaded via asyncio.to_thread. VAPID key is read from env each call — fine for correctness; if throughput ever matters, cache the parsed Vapid object.

services/push.py notify_new_order iterates ALL push_subscriptions and prunes non-admin ones on the fly; this is defensive but O(n) per new order. Consider filtering push_subscriptions by user_id ∈ admin_ids at query time to avoid per-doc db.users.find_one lookups.
chat.py mark_read intersects requested message_ids with sender_role=incoming_role to prevent a viewer marking their own messages as read — correct.
orders.py subscription guard is idempotent under race via the partial unique index; the pre-check + duplicate-key branch both surface the same FR 409 message. Verified.
Frontend build produced no warnings; bundle size stable vs iteration 3.

seed_data_creation: A handful of Prime/UC orders across freshly generated 10-digit pubg_ids and one QA customer + one 55-message chat conversation were created. Small volume; production data untouched.
mocked_scope_declaration: Only the HTTP transport of pywebpush was mocked (requests_session.post) — VAPID signing and aes128gcm payload encryption ran for real using the local env keys. No production endpoint was ever hit from the unit tests. All backend HTTP tests hit the real preview API. Real device/OS push delivery is out of scope for headless CI and remains a manual step.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ProtectedRoute deep-link fix is in place and covered by manual/UI verification (not yet by a Playwright regression file). If you want it locked in, add a Playwright test that (a) clears storage+cookies, (b) navigates to /admin/commandes?order=<id>, (c) logs in as admin, (d) asserts url contains order=<id> and [data-testid=notification-order-focus] exists. Push unit tests reload services.push once per module — do not import it at module top-level in new files unless VAPID env is guaranteed loaded first.
